title: Google begins certifying Registered App Stores for Android, but not in the US
summary: Easier app installs are coming to third-party stores, pending Google's stamp of approval.
llm_summary: Google has launched a new certification program that lets third‑party Android app stores earn an official “Registered App Store” badge, signaling they meet Google’s security and performance standards. While the program is rolling out globally, it currently excludes the United States, meaning U.S. users will still rely on the Play Store for vetted app installations. This move aims to make it easier and safer for users to install apps from alternative marketplaces.
